scope: Only supervised_process.py, supervisor_worker.py and a new mechanism test file; training/evaluation wiring is owned by the parent.

baseline.snapshot_provenance: Complete source bytes read and saved via apply_patch before production edits; hashes equal the two observed baseline modules. Not reconstructed after editing.

contract.shared: pass_fds are inherited by the supervisor and worker. The supervisor retains these descriptors through descendant drain/closure.
contract.worker_only: The blocked worker inherits worker_only_fds. The supervisor closes its copies after fork, inside owned cleanup and before READY.
contract.validation: Both groups are list/tuple, at most 64 combined descriptors; exact int >= 3, no duplicates within/across groups; all fstat checks succeed before Popen. Rejection is SupervisionUnavailable.
contract.caller_ownership: Caller originals remain owned by the caller. Their inheritable flags are unchanged.
contract.failure: A post-fork worker-only close failure emits no READY, enters the existing owned emergency drain, and does not retry an uncertain descriptor close.
contract.protocol: Only the private setup frame gains an optional worker_only_fds list. Persistent schema 1 binding and orze.linux_subreaper.v1 closure shape remain unchanged. Local descriptor numbers are not persisted as recovery authority.
contract.process_identity: The public pid remains the real blocked/executing worker PID, distinct from the supervisor PID.

test_classification.first_run: 10 new mechanisms first passed within the 23-test combined run; no absent-keyword/import failure was used as a red.
details: One actual CPU worker forks a surviving descendant. A pidfd observes real leader exit; the descendant closes its writer and lease copies. The parent observes attestation bytes then pipe EOF while poll/closure remain pending.

The same real-process test confirms an independent flock acquisition fails while the supervisor owns the shared lease, and succeeds after natural ECHILD_WALL closure; worker returncode remains 0 and exactly two children were reaped.

Eight parametrized invalid-descriptor mechanisms: bool, stdio FD, closed shared FD, closed worker-only FD, within-group duplicate, cross-group overlap, non-list/tuple container, and more than 64 combined FDs. Popen is a tripwire.

One stub-fork fault mechanism raises after the real worker-only close and verifies exactly one close attempt, owned drain, retained shared FD and ERROR without READY. This is exception-routing evidence, not real OS tree-closure evidence.
test_classification.fixture_changes: None after initial creation; no C2a or integration test/fixture assertions changed.

verification.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_supervised_worker_fds.py tests/test_supervised_process.py tests/test_supervisor_preparation_handoff.py --tb=short
verification.breakdown: 10 new C2b FD mechanisms + 10 unchanged C2a supervisor mechanisms + 3 unchanged C2a preparation handoff regressions.
verification.source_epoch: Hashes below; production paused after this target for independent review. This is not a full Core/Pro verification.

limits: New FD mechanisms do not establish native training/lineage wiring completion; the root owns those integrations and their acceptance.
No live GPU lease or real training/provider was used; the lease test is an actual local flock descriptor.
No hostile same-UID sandbox, process namespace escape containment or restart/adoption authority is claimed.
Parent-owned descriptors must not be concurrently closed/reassigned by the caller while prepare_supervised is acquiring them.
The inherited private supervisor socket and gate remain excluded from exec through the unchanged C2a implementation/test. Worker-only FDs intentionally survive exec.
independent_review: pro_review read the final two-file diff and reported no bounded FD-ownership blocker: strict preflight, supervisor closes worker-only copies before READY inside owned drain, no close retry, persistent schema unchanged and caller retains original FD ownership. This was a read-only review; pro_review had not rerun the 23 tests at report time.
